Describe the trigger, previous behavior, and the result of this change.

## Verification

List commands and observed results. Include multiprocessing cleanup and backpressure checks when relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and tests cover behavior.
- [ ] Comments and primary documentation are in English; designated README translations match the English version.
- [ ] Compatibility and changelog updates are included where needed.
- [ ] No confidential data, credentials, or unauthorized source/assets are included.
- [ ] Dependencies and third-party material have compatible licenses and required attribution.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed and its output has been reviewed.
